art.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: flat panoramic LED billboard texture for a large curved Times Square fashion screen.
Primary request: create original edge-to-edge fashion and beauty catalog artwork, 3072 by 1024 pixels or a high-resolution exact 3:1 panoramic canvas. Dense, tasteful collage of approximately 30 differently sized rectangular editorial photo panels, with thin, clean white gutters. Fill the entire wide canvas with the collage.
Subject: fictional diverse adult fashion models in everyday red, white, black, striped, pastel-green clothing, plus smaller still-life panels featuring shoes, handbags, sunglasses, cosmetics, and fabric closeups. Mix full-body fashion photos, waist-up portraits, detailed accessories and product photos. All people must clearly be adults.
Style/medium: crisp photorealistic premium high-street fashion editorial and catalog photography; polished magazine art direction with varied panel sizes and photographic crops. Bright off-white studio backgrounds, some soft foliage-green details. Balanced density across the full width, suitable to read as a lively fashion mosaic from street distance.
Color palette: bright off-white base, strong red accents, black, dark denim blue, soft pastel green and foliage green.
Lighting/mood: clean bright studio daylight, inviting and contemporary, clear details with natural skin texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: this is ONLY the flat finished advertising artwork, without perspective or any surrounding scene. No billboard hardware, building, storefront, streets, city, sky or outer mockup. No logos, brand marks, lettering, words, numerals, captions, watermarks or celebrity likenesses. No sexualized styling. Do not imitate any existing brand identity. Preserve a dense irregular grid of roughly 25 to 35 photographic rectangles separated by thin white gutters, with no large blank areas.
art.otherArtwork: Code-native Canvas lettering/seals/theatrical graphic and existing authored advertising/window atlases.

limitations: Reference-guided exterior interpretation, not a photographic or surveyed reconstruction. Source data governs the real footprint, setback and roof envelope.
Store names, campaigns, storefront splits, decorative dimensions and interior window imagery are fictional/authored.
Materials use static night shading and image-based window/screen emission rather than ray-traced light.
Native Canvas and actual Cesium Material/Primitive constructors checked. Browser/WebGL visual QA and live FPS measurement unavailable.
